<a id="what-an-extrapolation-can-learn-through-a-map--外推经映射所能学者"></a>
# What an extrapolation can learn through a map

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`learnable-through-registration` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F11 · [record](learnable-through-registration.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Configurations with one future through the map give every extrapolation the same prefix. In a listed world, some extrapolation rests on a feature everywhere exactly where such configurations have features eventually agreeing; under a still law, exactly where the feature respects the lumping.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. An extrapolation proposes a value of the feature from the prefix of a course through the map: the course through the map of a configuration's orbit (course); proposing the feature's value at every step from T on is resting from T (RestsFrom), and resting is resting from some T (Rests). (`Becoming.Learnable.course`, `Becoming.Learnable.RestsFrom`, `Becoming.Learnable.Rests`)
2. Two configurations with the same future through the map give every extrapolation the same prefix at every step; so at a step where their features differ a proposed value is right on at most one, with no decision, and with the feature's values decided a proposed value misses on one while the two prefixes stay equal at every step. (`Becoming.Learnable.prefixes_same`, `Becoming.Learnable.claim_not_right_on_both`, `Becoming.Learnable.missed_on_one`)
3. An extrapolation resting on both has features agreeing from some step on; so where they differ at arbitrarily late steps no extrapolation rests on both, already where the law leaves both configurations unchanged, the map does not tell them apart and their features differ. (`Becoming.Learnable.agree_of_rests_both`, `Becoming.Learnable.not_rests_on_both`, `Becoming.Learnable.orbit_of_still`, `Becoming.Learnable.still_not_rests_on_both`)
4. Where the feature is read off the map, the extrapolation over the lasso candidates on the values through the map, its proposals read off, rests on the feature in every world a list holds from the identification bound on; it is given neither the configurations, nor how many there are, nor any value of the feature. (`Becoming.Learnable.rests_through`)
5. Exactly: in a world a list holds, some extrapolation reading through the map rests at every configuration exactly where configurations with the same future through the map have features agreeing from some step on; the necessary side holds of every extrapolation, and the extrapolation of the sufficient side is built from the law, the map, the feature and the list. (`Becoming.Learnable.learnable_iff`, `Becoming.Learnable.fromLaw`, `Becoming.Learnable.fromLawAt`, `Becoming.Learnable.firstFit_congr`)
6. Features going alike across the map's lumping are learnable; under a law leaving every configuration unchanged, exactly those are. (`Becoming.Learnable.learnable_of_lumped`, `Becoming.Learnable.still_lumped_of_rests`, `Becoming.Learnable.still_learnable_iff_lumped`)
7. Two coordinates under a still law: with the map taking the first, no extrapolation rests on the second at both (true, false) and (true, true), the second not going alike across the first; with the map taking both, the lasso extrapolation rests from step 2. (`Becoming.Learnable.Pair.still`, `Becoming.Learnable.Pair.stays`, `Becoming.Learnable.Pair.first_not_rests`, `Becoming.Learnable.Pair.not_lumped`, `Becoming.Learnable.Pair.whole_rests`)
8. Along runs: a determined law's run gives an extrapolation its orbit's prefix, so the extrapolation rests on the run exactly where it rests on that orbit; runs beginning alike in the map's frame give every extrapolation one prefix; where a list holds the world, a feature is learnable along every run exactly where such runs have features agreeing from some step on, under a still law where it goes alike across the map's lumping. (`Becoming.LearnableRuns.course`, `Becoming.LearnableRuns.RestsFrom`, `Becoming.LearnableRuns.Rests`, `Becoming.LearnableRuns.prefix_eq`, `Becoming.LearnableRuns.restsFrom_iff`, `Becoming.LearnableRuns.rests_iff`, `Becoming.LearnableRuns.course_same`, `Becoming.LearnableRuns.prefixes_same`, `Becoming.LearnableRuns.agree_of_rests_both`, `Becoming.LearnableRuns.not_rests_on_both`, `Becoming.LearnableRuns.rests_through`, `Becoming.LearnableRuns.learnable_iff`, `Becoming.LearnableRuns.still_learnable_iff_lumped`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. Decidable equality of the values through the map (DecidableEq R) appears only as a condition of the lasso extrapolation and of fromLaw, in the statement of rests_through and the proof of learnable_iff; decidable equality of feature values (DecidableEq V) only in missed_on_one.
- Each theorem's conditions are written into it: the same future through the map; features differing at arbitrarily late steps; the orbit or the world held by a list; the feature read off the map (val s = g (reg s)); the law leaving configurations unchanged.
- In learnable_iff and its corollaries the configurations live in Type (the type of Identification.firstFit); the other theorems hold in every universe.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- The extrapolation of the sufficient side is built from the law, the map, the feature and the list; an extrapolation given nothing is shown only for features read off the map's present value. Witness: `Becoming.Learnable.rests_through`.
- Under a general law, learnable does not imply going alike across the map's lumping: a feature reading the map's next value is learnable without it.
- The condition is on pairs of configurations, not on each; reading it off needs the world.
- The extrapolation still tells the values through the map apart; learning where those values themselves are not told apart is not stated.
- No correspondence to human learning, neural networks, attention or perceptual thresholds is checked.
- **Counterexample:** Pair: with the map taking the first coordinate, no extrapolation rests on the second at both (true, false) and (true, true) (Pair.first_not_rests). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Learnable.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Stated for discrete steps. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Ren, 12 October 2026: “please, fully complete, 我觉得理更像是对结构和变化的规律的建模 finish wisdom root, and resolve the undissolved”. Extrapolation by elimination (then called learning by refutation) left learning where the map does not tell values apart unstated. This result states it: what an extrapolation can learn through a map is exactly where configurations with the same future through the map agree from some step on. Readings (the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation): the map bounds what is learned; on Ren's reading 理 is the modeling of the laws of structure and of change, and that modeling is learned through the map as it is tested through what couples in; a difference below threshold (a condition coupled in by threshold only passes only whether it meets the need) is learnable only where it shows in the future through the map or vanishes from the feature; what lies beyond the map is reached only by widening it: new coupling by level, another's couplings.

### Dependencies

- **formal-reuse**: [learning-by-refutation](learning-by-refutation.md). Reuses prefixOf, prefix_congr, prefix_length, Misses, Lumped, byElimination, lassos and tri: the extrapolation, the prefix, missing and lumping.
  - Output: Extrapolations and prefixes of courses through a map; extrapolation by elimination; lumping.
  - Input: An extrapolation reading through a map resting on a feature.
  - Preserved conditions: The lasso extrapolation needs the values through the map decided. [Learning.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Learning.lean)
- **formal-reuse**: [identification-where-bounded](identification-where-bounded.md). Reuses held_byElimination_rests (the step at which the extrapolation not given the bound rests), Law.name, Law.sameFuture_iff_below, prefix_eq_iff, firstFit, firstFit_sound and firstFit_found.
  - Output: A bounded prefix fixes the future through the map; the step at which the extrapolation not given the bound rests.
  - Input: A feature read off the map learned within the bound; the extrapolation built from the law.
  - Preserved conditions: The world or the orbit held by a list. [Identification.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Identification.lean)
- **formal-reuse**: [configurations-alike-by-relation](configurations-alike-by-relation.md). Reuses Law.SameFuture: the same future through the map.
  - Output: Configurations with the same future through the map.
  - Input: The same prefix.
  - Preserved conditions: None. [Recurrence.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Recurrence.lean)
- **formal-reuse**: [seeking-boundary](seeking-boundary.md). Reuses Law.fixed_rests: a configuration the law leaves unchanged is its own orbit.
  - Output: A still configuration stays.
  - Input: Two still configurations.
  - Preserved conditions: The law leaving the configuration unchanged. [Seeking.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Seeking.lean)
- **formal-reuse**: [recurrence-without-premise](recurrence-without-premise.md). Reuses Law.orbit.
  - Output: Orbits.
  - Input: Courses through a map.
  - Preserved conditions: None. [Recurrence.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Recurrence.lean)
- related, not a proved adapter: [generalization-through-lumping](generalization-through-lumping.md). Under a still law, the learnable features are exactly those going alike across the map's lumping; the lumping generalization goes through is the one the map gives.
- related, not a proved adapter: [subthreshold-registration](subthreshold-registration.md). A condition coupled in by threshold only passes only whether it meets the need; read for extrapolations, a difference below threshold is learnable only where it shows in the future through the map or vanishes from the feature (a reading).
- related, not a proved adapter: [wisdom-root-part-one](wisdom-root-part-one.md). Its learning clause read through a map: an extrapolation learns no more than the future through the map tells apart.
